task_summary: Implement the requested word-counting behavior in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only within the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Split text on arbitrary whitespace, casefold each token, and count tokens; retain punctuation as part of each token.
Return {} for empty or whitespace-only text.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Add at least two passing unittest methods covering ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs; verify with unittest discovery.

success_criteria.description: The implementation and tests contain the requested word-count behavior and unittest coverage.

check.rubric: Read solution.py and test_solution.py. Determine whether the public implementation splits text on arbitrary whitespace, casefolds each token before counting it, preserves punctuation within tokens, and returns {} for empty or whitespace-only input. Check that type hints are maintained, input collections are not mutated, and test_solution.py contains at least two unittest test methods exercising ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs. Assess only content visible in these files.

assumptions: The named files solution.py and test_solution.py are relative to the supplied workspace; either may not exist yet and may be created.
The requested implementation is a public word-counting API, but its function name and exact signature are unspecified; the contract leaves those choices for review and implementation.
The stated ordinary, boundary, and empty-input coverage is interpreted as requiring tests for token counting, whitespace splitting and casefolding, plus empty and whitespace-only text.
